t: You're looking at Peel Cottage, a historic house in Kensington. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, one of the great British architects, best known for his country houses and commercial buildings. The house was commissioned by Matthew Ridley Corbet, a Victorian neoclassical painter, who lived here. Another artist later lived here too: the Scottish painter and illustrator Sir William Russell Flint, known especially for his watercolours of women. So this is a house with architects and painters woven through its story.
